name: The Ziggurat Gambit
description: Defeat the Ziggurat while enemy armor is thicker and enemy phase ships are quicker than ever.
flavor: The thing in the dark has waited a long time. Make it wait a little longer.

name: Iron Gauntlet
description: Win 20 battles against enemies who are tougher, deadlier and better armored.
flavor: Twenty fights. No mercy asked and none given.

name: The Lone Admiral
description: Win 10 battles with fewer officers, green crews and fewer command points.
flavor: Nobody else is coming. It is you and your ship.

name: Blitz
description: Win 10 battles within 90 days while enemies are faster and hit harder.
flavor: There is no time to rest between fights.

name: Big Game
description: Within 180 days, beat three fleets at least twice the size of your side, while enemy officers are sharper and their ships carry extra hull mods.
flavor: Pick fights you should not win. Win them.

name: Junkyard Baron
description: Win 15 battles while D-mods bite harder, wrecks break apart and repairs crawl.
flavor: Rust is a way of life.

name: The Long Night
description: Last a full year while every other fleet is bigger, better built and faster on the map.
flavor: A year of running in the dark.

name: Lean Years
description: Last half a year while your crew eats, your ships burn supplies and your tanks leak.
flavor: Count every crate. Then count it again.

name: Merchant's Gauntlet
description: Hold a million credits while every port gouges you and your own clerks steal from you.

name: Colonial Empire
description: Own five colonies while your colonists grumble, your works crumble and the trade lanes pass you by.
flavor: An empire is built one unhappy world at a time.

name: Ordo Hunt
description: Defeat three Remnant fleets while enemies vent faster, last longer and shrug off damage.
flavor: The machines do not tire. Neither can you.

name: Fortress Breaker
description: Win three battles against orbital stations while enemy armor and hull are thicker and their guns reach farther.
flavor: Walls are only as strong as the fleet that holds them.

name: Pilgrim's Ordeal
description: Walk the Pilgrim's Path while your crew goes hungry, your drives drag and repairs come slowly.
flavor: The path is long. That is the point.

name: Sol Expedition
description: Finish the Translocator quest in Sol while every fleet is bigger, enemy guns reach farther and your drives drag.
flavor: The old home system does not give up its secrets easily.

name: High Roller
description: Win 10 spins at the Gambling Den while every port gouges you and your clerks skim your income.
flavor: Luck is a skill. Ask anyone at the tables.

name: Omega Apprentice
description: Train an officer under an Omega core while enemy phase ships are quicker and enemy guns fire faster.
flavor: The shard has much to teach. Survive the lessons.

name: Ascendant
description: Ascend a colony past size 10 while colonists grumble, works crumble and the worlds fight back.
flavor: Build higher than the sky allows.
